name: The Suiri ~Aratanaru 20 no Jikenbo~
original_name: THE推理 〜新たなる20の事件簿〜
source:
Player becomes a detective that has to unravel the mystery of incidents. There are 20 episodes each taking from 5 to 15 minutes. Collect tips by clicking on the screen and then answer the questions.
